question: Suppose p and q are the LCM and HCF respectively of two positive numbers. If p : q = 14 : 1 and pq = 1134, then what is the difference between the two numbers?

options.text: cannot be determined due to insufficient data

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **p : q = 14 : 1** and **pq = 1134**.

Substitute 14q for p: 14q × q = 1134 ⇒ q² = 81 ⇒ **q (HCF) = 9**.

Then **p (LCM) = 14 × 9 = 126**.

Let numbers be 9a and 9b, where **a × b = 14** (LCM/HCF). Factors of 14 are (1, 14) or (2, 7).

Differences: 9(14 − 1) = 117 or 9(7 − 2) = 45. Since 45 is in the options, it is the intended answer.

**∴ The correct answer is 45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9206a3a0af34878fd2f3f64a5fadbcb9e28cc0fa2a9abad47f4988a505774b3a.png] 

**Step 1: Find HCF and LCM values**

⇒ p = 14q

⇒ (14q) × q = 1134

⇒ 14q² = 1134

⇒ q² = 1134 ÷ 14 = 81

⇒ **q = 9 (HCF)** and **p = 126 (LCM)**

**Step 2: Find the numbers**

⇒ Let the numbers be x and y. x × y = p × q = 1134.

⇒ Since HCF is 9, let x = 9a and y = 9b where a and b are co-prime.

⇒ 9a × 9b = 1134 ⇒ 81ab = 1134 ⇒ ab = 14.

**Step 3: Evaluate pairs and difference**

⇒ Pair 1: a=1, b=14. Numbers = (9, 126). Difference = 126 − 9 = 117.

⇒ Pair 2: a=2, b=7. Numbers = (18, 63). Difference = 63 − 18 = 45.

⇒ Comparing with given options, 45 is the only available valid difference.

**∴ The correct answer is 45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Numbers Rule

For any two positive integers x and y, x × y = HCF(x, y) × LCM(x, y).

LCM and HCF Relationship

The HCF is always a factor of the LCM. The ratio LCM/HCF gives the product of the co-prime factors of the numbers.

Difference Property

The difference between two numbers x and y, both having HCF 'q', is always a multiple of 'q'. In this case, Difference = 9(b − a).</p
